findings.title: The schema example normalizes P1 to medium before validation
findings.failure_scenario: A validator selecting proof requirements from normalized_severity applies medium rules to an original P1 and loses the distinction between normalization and final demotion.
findings.safeguard_gap: The schema enum accepts the contradictory values and the fixture validates.
findings.recheck: schema example or severity semantics change

findings.title: Unknown has no defined projection into the existing agent-review verdict/action vocabulary
findings.failure_scenario: Unknown must become pass, needs-fix, or block and none, resume, refresh, or fork; every inferred choice changes recovery semantics, while unknown/inspect is contract-invalid.
findings.safeguard_gap: Compatibility tests are requested without a normative mapping table.

findings.title: Global completion contradicts compatibility-mode producer-status retention
findings.failure_scenario: Advisory mode retains producer Needs Fix with zero actionable findings, satisfying Book 06 but violating the top-level global-completion owner.
findings.safeguard_gap: No precedence rule resolves the top-level completion owner against the sole compatibility owner.
findings.owner: top-level completion owner with books 01/06 compatibility owners

findings.title: Missing task/run identity has no canonical schema representation
findings.failure_scenario: Unavailable identity must be omitted/null and fail schema, or be empty and pass the sidecar schema while failing projection or collapsing attribution keys.
findings.safeguard_gap: The schema accepts ambiguous empty strings and the plan defines no nullable or synthetic-ID policy.

findings.title: Chapter 6 profile ownership summaries omit architecture and performance
findings.failure_scenario: Coverage checks following the summary tables can omit architecture/performance catalog ownership while the byte-range source audit still passes.
findings.safeguard_gap: Source-range coverage does not enforce semantic enumeration in Books 02 and 99.
